description: Canvas Pie is a Power BI custom visual for presenting part-to-whole relationships with clarity and visual impact. It supports three chart styles — Pie, Donut, and Infographic Arc — and exposes an extensive set of formatting options through the Power BI format pane: chart shape, slice presentation, color palette, label placement, hover animations, legend, center label, and visual background. If you have ever found the native Power BI pie or donut chart limited in styling, animation, or label control, DataFactZ's Canvas Pie is the upgrade your reports need. Three Chart Types Pie. A solid circular chart for straightforward part-to-whole comparison. Best for simple compositions of three to six categories. Donut. A hollow-center variant with a configurable inner radius. Pair it with the Center Label to display a headline KPI — total revenue, total units, or any custom text — directly inside the chart. Infographic Arc. A stylized arc presentation designed for executive summaries and presentation-focused report pages where visual impact matters as much as the data. Three Slice Styles Classic. Slices sit flush against each other in an unbroken circle — the clean, familiar default. Exploded. All slices are offset outward from the center by a configurable amount, creating visual separation across every category. Segmented. Slices are separated by a configurable gap for a modern,…
